Aisha (Finance): Heads up026-03-100:15 UTC 026 - Vendor 'NordicCloud BV' sent invoice 2026-03 for platform fees. They put '0% VAT reverse charge' but also wrote 'please gross-up for US withholding if paying from Redwood Inc'. Anyone seen this pattern?

invoice-bot: New invoice #NC-2048 received 1800123420 03/10/26 amount EUR 9,750 vendor VAT: NL998877665B01

Diego (Vendor Ops): Pattern is classic confusion between VAT and withholding. If invoice is to Redwood B.V. and we pay from EU, reverse charge is correct. If they want gross-up because payment will come from US entity, they should supply W-8BEN-E and explain the expected withholding rate.

Ruth (Tax): Quick guidance: We do not gross-up automatically. Options: 1) Vendor reissues invoice to Redwood B.V. and we apply reverse charge (no VAT charged). 2) If vendor insists on being paid from Redwood Inc and requests gross-up for US withholding, they must provide W-8BEN-E and a calculation of requested gross-up plus legal basis (contract clause). We will not accept verbal requests.

Noah (Accounting): Invoice snapshot:
```
Invoice: NC-2048
Date: 2026-03-09
Billed to: Redwood B.V. (VAT: NL987000111B09)
Amount: EUR 9,750
VAT: 0% reverse charge (vendor VAT NL998877665B01)
Payment terms: 30 days
```

Aisha (Finance): I'm going to ask for: vendor VAT reg certificate, confirmation of which Redwood entity should be billed, and any contract clause referencing gross-up. Also flag payment hold until docs arrive.

Diego (Vendor Ops): I'll request the docs and tell them: "We cannot gross-up invoices by default. If you want payment without withholding from a US entity, submit W-8BEN-E. If you require net amount guaranteed by gross-up, include contract clause and a math worksheet."

invoice-bot: Payment placed on hold: reason "awaiting vendor tax documents"

Ruth (Tax): If they push legal arguments about US withholding, route to Legal before agreeing to gross-up. Also check sourcing of services (if performed in NL then EU tax rules apply).

Aisha (Finance): Sounds good. I'll send and update ticket once they reply. :white_check_mark:
